description: This Java source file defines the ProductionRunHelper class, which provides utility methods for managing production runs within the manufacturing module of the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to retrieve production run details, check for specific tasks, find linked production runs, and identify the root production run in a dependency chain.

classes.name: ProductionRunHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for managing production run data and relations within the manufacturing module.

methods.name: getProductionRun
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a production run, including associated products, components, and routing tasks, given a delegator and production run ID.

methods.name: hasTask
methods.description: Checks if a specific task exists within a production run based on the task name and work effort ID.

methods.name: getLinkedProductionRuns
methods.description: Recursively collects all production runs linked via precedence relationships, starting from a given production run ID.

methods.name: getRootProductionRun
methods.description: Finds the root production run in a precedence chain starting from a specified production run ID.
